Laser sheet's joints (mitcad#1939) for tools/ui-scripts/laser-sheet.mitcad-ui: a front plate 100 x 6 x 60 (Body1) and a side plate 6 x 80 x 60 (Body2) overlapping at the corner; a plate 100 x 60 x 6 lying at y = 200 (Body3, its end face F3:side1 at x = 100, 60 long along y) and its mate 6 x 20 x 40 against the end's first third (Body4), so that the end face's middle shows.
